Settings.BridgeEnabledHint: Let the active GM client connect to the Quick Shop MCP server so Claude Code can manage shops. See modules/quick-shop/mcp/README.md for setup.
Settings.BridgePortHint: Local port the MCP server listens on. Must match QUICK_SHOP_PORT on the Claude Code side (default 30310).
Settings.BridgeTokenHint: Optional shared secret. If set, it must match QUICK_SHOP_TOKEN on the Claude Code side.
Settings.BridgeUrlHint: Leave empty to connect to ws://localhost:<port> on the machine this browser runs on. That also works when Foundry itself is hosted (The Forge, a VPS). Set a full ws:// or wss:// URL only when Claude Code runs on a different machine, for example through a tunnel.
